name: Drum Highway

midi-input.description: Reads the e-kit/MIDI-pad input through the core midi-input domain (Web-MIDI provider ships built-in with the domain). Absent domain → no MIDI devices, fail-soft.

gamepad-input.description: Claims one game controller (an Xbox-style pad or a plastic drum kit) through the core gamepad-input domain while a drum part plays, and reads its buttons and axes as drum hits. Absent domain: no controller, fail-soft.

description: Drum chart playback on a Rock Band-style 3D drum track or a 2D lane view, with scoring, difficulty levels (Easy to Expert+), star power and assists.
